```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
# them but doesn't run them again.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(engine = function(options) {
  if (options$engine == "bash") options$eval <- FALSE
  options
})
```

Binning of the assembled contigs into genomes with MetaBAT 2. Commands for this step were run in `metabat/`.

To assess contig depth, contig names and their sequencing depths were extracted from the `Flye` assembly information file to create the depth file required for binning. The assembled contigs were also reorder to match the order of contigs in the depth file. 

```{bash}
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly_info.txt  | grep -v '#' | 

awk '{OFS="\t";print $1,$3}' > depths_bbd.txt

cat depths_bbd.txt | awk '{print $1}' | xargs samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta > assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta
```

Finally, `metaBAT 2` was used to group the reordered contigs into bins based on sequence composition, and contig depth.
